title: 3 Manual Shifting Mistakes Every Driver Makes (Part 1)

script.narration: Stop resting your hand there! Resting your hand on the gear shifter while driving ruins your transmission.

script.narration: This puts pressure on the internal selector fork, causing premature wear and costly damage.

script.narration: Follow for Part 2 to see the next big shifting mistake, or you'll keep doing it. Stop resting your hand there!

description: Learn the hidden habit that ruins manual transmissions fast. Part 1 of our manual driving mistakes series reveals why you should keep your hands on the steering wheel.
